about: Nauta's sounds (tools/sound/README.md). Every take made with the newest ByteDance Seed Audio through OpenRouter by @futuremagic/audio's make script. No voices anywhere (Arnd). Beds come in two takes (a, b) that the game blends slowly, so no loop is heard.

sounds.about: Synthesised by tools/sound/pipe.mjs from pipe-calls.json: A course for the master (steer, come up, bear away, full and by): the short call that the word is passed, two quick high notes and a drop.

Synthesised by tools/sound/pipe.mjs from pipe-calls.json: Tack (all hands about ship): the general call, the low note rising to a warbled high and falling, then Haul Taut, a short low note snapped up to the high.
Synthesised by tools/sound/pipe.mjs from pipe-calls.json: Wear (all hands wear ship): the general call, then Veer, the high note gliding slowly down to the low.
Synthesised by tools/sound/pipe.mjs from pipe-calls.json: Heave to: the general call cut short, then Belay, a held high note, a low catch and a high note cut off: make fast, she stops.
Synthesised by tools/sound/pipe.mjs from pipe-calls.json: Make sail (battle, plain, all sail): Away Aloft, a trilled low note, then Hoist, the low note rising slowly to a high one held and warbled.
Synthesised by tools/sound/pipe.mjs from pipe-calls.json: Shorten sail: Away Aloft, a trilled low note, then Lower, a high note gliding slowly down to a trilled low one.
Synthesised by tools/sound/pipe.mjs from pipe-calls.json: Back a topsail (man the braces): Haul, three pulls, each a low note (the pause) snapped up to the high (the pull).
Synthesised by tools/sound/pipe.mjs from pipe-calls.json: Fill (let draw): Heave Round, the notes rolling warbled from low to high and back, ending on the low.
Synthesised by tools/sound/pipe.mjs from pipe-calls.json: Haul away, piped as she comes through the wind or round before it (tacked, wore), when the yards are swung: two quick pulls.

Synthesised by tools/sound/pipe.mjs from pipe-calls.json: The Still: one high plain note, ended sharply; every man stops what he is doing. Piped when she misses stays. Shortened from the Navy's eight seconds.
Synthesised by tools/sound/pipe.mjs from pipe-calls.json: Carry On: a short high note falling to the low; the work is done, the men go back to what they were doing.
Synthesised by tools/sound/pipe.mjs from pipe-calls.json: Hands to the pumps: the general call cut short, then three slow strokes of the pump brakes.
Synthesised by tools/sound/pipe.mjs from pipe-calls.json: Fire party: three urgent trilled high notes.
Synthesised by tools/sound/pipe.mjs from pipe-calls.json: Clear the wreckage: Away, then two sharp chops.
